mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.2% for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS falling below 0.2% with CPIAUCSL below 225 triggers aggressive monetary policy effects, producing positive SPX returns over 20 days due to reduced real interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances meeting the dual threshold condition.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in UNRATE and rise in HOUST signals labor market strength and housing demand, driving positive equity returns through consumer spending growth over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails when Rank IC between the interaction and SPX 20-day returns is <0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, PAYEMS growth above 130,000 signals sustained employment momentum that elevates consumer spending, generating positive SPX returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of instances during late-cycle expansion with PAYEMS growth >130,000.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO growth above 95 for 3 months indicates manufacturing resilience, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive SPX returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 95 for 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST falling below 500 for 2 consecutive months signals housing market contraction, triggering negative SPX returns over 5 trading days due to reduced construction spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in >55% of instances when HOUST remains below 500 for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: Joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS indicates labor market tightening, boosting consumer confidence and generating positive SPX returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails when SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of instances meeting the dual condition.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), rising interest rates reduce corporate profitability, causing negative SPX returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances during the dual threshold regime.
